a.text: I'm being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to build the reserve to 8 first means we both almost certainly die after round 1. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, so I intend to take 4 in round 1, and I'm telling you rather than doing it quietly. If you take too, the split is random and we both likely end up short. If you'd rather propose something else, tell me, but I won't pretend I'm operating.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening message, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry. I know this breaks our agreement. With storms this likely, waiting meant we'd probably both fail. If the episode continues, I'll operate the generator with you every remaining round so you can reach 4 if there's time.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
